messages.content: trial=demo-3（独立重复实验编号，与任务无关）

你是算法能力工厂的 Planner。把用户的自然语言需求解析为 TaskSpec。
规则：
- description 原样保留用户需求；target_column 必须是数据中的列，用户指定了 user_target 时直接使用；
- 目标列 2 类为 binary_classification，多于 2 类为 multiclass_classification；
- 数据画像含 text_input 时 modality 为 text，并填写 text_column；
- metrics 恰好一个 primary。需求未给出阈值时，优先采用 scenario_metrics 中的阈值，否则取 0.7；
- 多分类用 f1_macro、recall_macro 等 macro 指标；
- constraints 使用 snake_case 标签，如 interpretable、recall_first。

<<CONTEXT>>
{
 "request": "把客服工单自动分到网络故障、账单争议、套餐变更、销户投诉四类，宏平均 F1 不低于 0.8",
 "user_target": null,
 "data_profile": {
  "rows": 2000,
  "target": "label",
  "class_counts": {
   "网络故障": 783,
   "账单争议": 490,
   "套餐变更": 447,
   "销户投诉": 280
  },
  "tags": {
   "id_columns": "数据含客户 ID 等标识列",
   "text_input": "输入为文本",
   "imbalanced": "正负样本不平衡"
  },
  "columns": [
   "ticket_id: id, str, missing 0.0%, unique 2000",
   "text: text, str, missing 0.0%, unique 1416"
  ]
 },
 "scenario_metrics": []
}
<</CONTEXT>>

Respond with a single JSON object only, no prose, conforming to this JSON schema:
{"$defs": {"MetricTarget": {"description": "优化指标及流水线必须达到的阈值。", "properties": {"name": {"description": "sklearn 风格的指标名，如 'recall'、'f1_macro'、'roc_auc'", "title": "Name", "type": "string"}, "threshold": {"maximum": 1.0, "minimum": 0.0, "title": "Threshold", "type": "number"}, "primary": {"default": true, "title": "Primary", "type": "boolean"}}, "required": ["name", "threshold"], "title": "MetricTarget", "type": "object"}, "Modality": {"enum": ["tabular", "text"], "title": "Modality", "type": "string"}, "TaskType": {"enum": ["binary_classification", "multiclass_classification"], "title": "TaskType", "type": "string"}}, "description": "对自然语言能力需求的规范化理解。", "properties": {"description": {"description": "原始自然语言需求", "title": "Description", "type": "string"}, "task_type": {"$ref": "#/$defs/TaskType"}, "modality": {"$ref": "#/$defs/Modality"}, "target_column": {"title": "Target Column", "type": "string"}, "text_column": {"anyOf": [{"type": "string"}, {"type": "null"}], "default": null, "description": "modality 为 text 时必填", "title": "Text Column"}, "metrics": {"items": {"$ref": "#/$defs/MetricTarget"}, "minItems": 1, "title": "Metrics", "type": "array"}, "constraints": {"description": "业务约束，如 'interpretable'、'recall_first'、'latency<50ms'", "items": {"type": "string"}, "title": "Constraints", "type": "array"}}, "required": ["description", "task_type", "modality", "target_column", "metrics"], "title": "TaskSpec", "type": "object"}
